The alloy was firstly melted into ingots using a WK-II vacuum arc-melting furnace. In the melting process, the chamber was vacuumed to 0.1 bar first, then gassed with argon (99.999%); after repeatedly cleaning the atmosphere, the materials were arc-melted under argon atmosphere. The button-shaped sample was turned over and remelted more than 6 times to homogenize the composition of the entire ingot.
